metadata.title: Shared Collaborative Workspaces

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for persistent, multi-modal digital collaboration spaces supporting teams, projects, courses, and communities.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Collaborative workspaces, team-based collaboration platforms, persistent digital rooms, and shared collaboration containers.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for persistent collaboration environments that aggregate messaging, file sharing, meetings, and automation under a governed lifecycle.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Workspace membership, channels, messages, shared files, automation bindings, activity history, and lifecycle metadata.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Shared workspaces inherit baseline collaboration trust, accountability, and lifecycle guarantees from Collaboration Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Shared workspaces frequently span organizational and trust boundaries, requiring explicit definition of roles, access, and responsibilities.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Workspaces routinely include remote participants operating from unmanaged environments.

metadata.remarks: Shared Collaborative Workspaces define persistent collaboration environments that combine communication, content, and coordination over time. Unlike individual chats or meetings, workspaces accumulate institutional knowledge and risk through persistence, automation, and long-lived membership. This pattern governs membership, scope, lifecycle, and accountability while composing other Secure Collaboration modalities.

components.title: Workspace Membership Governance
components.description: Controls who may create, join, invite others to, or administer collaborative workspaces.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships through unmanaged or over-permissive workspace membership.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts to persist within shared workspaces beyond intended authorization.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit role-based membership control constrains workspace access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Workspace membership is explicitly defined and periodically reviewed.
Enforcement mechanisms restrict unauthorized workspace access.

components.title: Workspace Scope and Boundary Control
components.description: Constrains how a workspace may be used and limits unintended expansion of scope or exposure.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of information from long-lived or broadly scoped collaboration workspaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Boundary definition and lifecycle controls reduce unintended workspace persistence.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define permitted workspace scope and lifecycle expectations.

components.title: Workspace Activity Observability
components.description: Provides visibility into activity across workspace modalities for governance and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence within collaboration workspaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and cross-modality traceability support accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Workspace activity events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports investigation of collaboration misuse.
